thread:
maria: Quick sync — AcmeHealth and BetaCorp pushed back asking for dashboards + per-customer cost breakdown + error analytics before GA. We need to agree minimum scope for the next release (not a full visibility surface).
quan: Can we define a narrow slice? My concern: tracing hooks + cost breakdown both touch infra and billing surfaces. That's two big cross-team efforts.
nashley: Agree. From SRE ops POV, tracing hooks require only 1 small agent change if we limit to sampling + span tagging for LLM calls. Full distributed tracing (context propagation across internal services) is bigger.
sam: Design preference: start with a lightweight "insights" dashboard that shows request volume, p50/p95 latency, error-rate, and a cost delta widget. Keep table filters simple.
lisa: Sales note — customers care about per-tenant token cost and error attribution. If we can show a per-customer cost line + top 3 error reasons, it's a win.
quan: Proposal: Scope = (1) Basic dashboards (volume/latency/errors) with templated widgets, (2) Tracing hooks limited to LLM request spans + span-level tags for model, route, and customer_id, (3) Cost breakdown: per-route and per-customer tokens using existing billing feed (no new billing pipeline). No cross-service trace stitching.
maria: That feels reasonable. Need to confirm acceptance criteria and an engineering estimate. Can someone draft acceptance criteria? @quan @ashley
ashley: Draft acceptance criteria inline: ```
- Dashboard: pre-built "LLM Health" dashboard that surfaces p50/p95 latency, requests/min, error-rate (%) and a top-10 slow routes table.
- Tracing hooks: every LLM request emits a span with tags: model, route, customer_id, seq_len. Sampling defaults to 10% for GA.
- Cost breakdown: daily per-customer token counts and cost estimate, exposed in dashboard and CSV export. Uses current billing feed; does not modify pricing.
- Error analytics: aggregate top 5 error messages by route and customer, with quick link to raw logs (S3/ELK).
- Rollout: feature flagged per-customer; rollout initial for BetaCorp, AcmeHealth then wider if metrics stable.
```
quan: Engineering notes: sampling + span tags + CSV export are straightforward. Per-customer token attribution relies on request metadata (we already pass customer_id in headers). Risk: billing feed has ~2hr lag; call that out in UX. Estimate: 3 sprints for eng-platform (2 engs), 1 sprint for frontend (1 eng + designer).
maria: Good. Prioritization ask: if we only get capacity for one item this quarter, which should it be? Dashboards, tracing hooks, or cost breakdown?
sam: Dashboards first — they unlock visibility while being highest customer-facing bang-for-buck.
lisa: Sales says cost breakdown drives renewals for a couple of accounts, so if we have to choose, cost breakdown ties directly to $$ retention.
ashley: Ops risk calc: tracing hooks give fastest debugging velocity for oncall. If ops load is our bottleneck, pick tracing hooks.
quan: My recommendation: sprint A = dashboards + cost breakdown (parallel low-risk tasks). Sprint B = tracing hooks + rollout/flags. That sequence minimizes immediate churn and gives customers the cost numbers they ask for.
maria: Decision: follow quan's recommendation unless PMs push otherwise. Action items: @quan scope ETA + PRs, @sam mockups for pre-built dashboard by Tue, @lisa gather 2 customer quotes for release notes, @ashley confirm sampling defaults and oncall playbook. I'll document GA gating criteria.
observability-bot: New doc created: https://redwood.internal/docs/observe/minimum-surface (private) :bookmark_tabs:
maria: One more thing — GA gating: we want no >2x regression in median latency for 99% of routes after hooks enablement, cost accuracy within 5% for per-customer daily totals, and SLO for dashboard load time <1.5s for typical queries. I'll add these to the doc.
quan: Noted. I'll add an entry to the infra risk register and flag any quota/billing API changes.
lisa: I'll line up a short customer-facing FAQ and a preview webinar for BetaCorp.
ashley: Will prepare a short runbook for oncall with pointers to new spans + how to interpret sampling artifacts.
maria: Thanks all — I'll follow up with a short RFC and schedule a 30m decision sync tomorrow. :thumbsup:
